Guard auth TOCTOU: норматив 09 §1 принимает ACL window между precheck и row lock. В P3 нет повторной ACL проверки В SQL transaction и нет lock всего ACL graph; ни тест, ни docs не обещают мгновенную отмену уже admitted mutation. Повтор на следующем API call/job/complete обязателен. Tenancy/data invariants под lock остаются обязательны. Public share revoke имеет linearization: запрос, начинающий проверку после revoke commit, получает 404; уже открытый byte stream не отзывной. Нельзя называть его guarantee уничтожения bytes in flight.
System не отменяет ProfileRestriction по accepted D27=A; ужесточение OPUS 09 §1 шаг 3 принято D27=A. P3.1 имеет пустой profile seam; P3.6 подключает реальный ProfilePolicy и ProfileGuardBoundaryTest. Boot/feature gate checks не исчезают из-за host permission override.
Purge foundation P3.3: Document/Shortcut purge-only поддержаны, physical node deletion и inline FK cascade atomic; unsupported copy preflight ВСЕГО subtree до writes. Root failure rollback+report не останавливает следующие roots; PurgeTrashCommand exit1, empty throws первое unexpected исключение только после обхода; одиночный purge throws после rollback. Доказательство: documents PG PurgeTrashCascadeTest, drive PurgeTrashTest и OperationMatrixTest.
I10: D26C evidence/enforcement/work раздельны, COPY/restoreRevision соблюдают destination policy и не наследуют grandfathering; required без compatible clean blocks. Durable work/late fencing по I17.

I17: Every new required revision имеет atomic own durable scan obligation; legacy eligibility transition atomically records bounded durable backfill discovery and blocks bytes until compatible evidence, per-revision work is materialized from crash-safe cursor; commit→publish crash/lease expiry recoverable, late attempts не снимают infected, evidence compatibility не определяется одним digest. Enforcement: P3.7 ScanWorkRecovery/ScanEvidenceBoundary; P3.8 PG barrier.
I18: Sequence — editorial aggregate, HTTP representation validators cover all actual dependencies; no-op/stale/idempotent replay имеют отдельные semantics. P3.3/P4.7 writer map; P6 ETag/304/preconditions contract.

Принято D27=A. OperationGuard сначала связывает persisted drive/tenant/node и actor; публичный asSystem(reason) обходит только ACL. Scope, profile restrictions, hierarchy/data invariants и content egress policy обязательны. ACL-derived abilities не переиспользуются между requests. User View precedes visible policy errors, чтобы не раскрывать скрытые nodes. Профиль сужает allow predicates.
Разделить операции public content egress, metadata/mutation, private scanner read и maintenance purge/GC. Private scanner получает service-internal минимальную capability на конкретный immutable blob/revision/scope/attempt; ему нужны raw bytes quarantined revision, но capability не даёт public URL/stream/route и не является public system bypass. Проверять authoritative job scope до bytes. Purge/GC может удалить infected content, сохраняя tenant/tree/CAS safety, и не требует download/upload feature; feature guards применяются по операции. Хостовый PHP процесс — доверенная интеграция, а не sandbox против вредоносного host code. P3.1 — seam, P3.6 — wiring, P3.8 — strict tenant/job boundary.

## Система операций, ресурсов и interfering pairs

Ресурсы: S=session advisory+row; T=drive tree shared/exclusive; N=nodes sorted canonical key; F=file row; R=revision rows; Q=drive quota conditional UPDATE; C=CAS scope+sha advisory; G=grant/share row; A=activity/outbox inserts. Единственный порядок внутри каждой family: S (только uploads) → T → N → F → R → Q → C → A. Tree-sensitive structural operations используют exclusive T, file/revision/create используют shared T. Нельзя Q→F, C→Q/T, N→T, F→S; не берём S в drive actions. Foreign models не вносят foreign lock key.
| Pair | Shared resources / expected serialization | Test |
| rename/create/upload same name | T+parent N+sibling unique; conflict policy retry <=5 | existing SameNameUploadRaceTest + new NameConflictPolicyTest |
| move vs move/copy/trash/restore/purge | exclusive T+sorted N, CTE invariants под lock | existing TreeConcurrency tests, P3 OperationMatrix |
| two writers same node expectedSequence=7 | T shared/exclusive by operation → same N lock; expected comparison before side effects+bump in same tx; one success seq8, one StaleNodeException412, loser zero side effects | packages/drive/tests/Concurrency/NodeSequenceBoundaryTest.php, P3.3/V9 PG ForkRace; phase/V920 |
| addRevision vs addRevision/restore/prune | shared T + node N → F → R; head/delta/number from locked F | RevisionNumberRace + new RestoreRevisionConcurrencyTest |
| upload vs quota competing new file/copy | Q conditional UPDATE, ordered after aggregate locks | QuotaRace/CopyQuotaRace existing |
| ingest vs GC/reconcile on same blob | C same scope+sha, edge counted under existing CAS saga | media BlobCommitAtomicity/GC regressions |
| complete vs complete/abort/sweep/tus patch | S existing API mutex, persisted terminal pointers | UploadSessionCriticalSection + CompleteRaceTest |
| scan verdict vs head replacement/purge | no network inside tx; identity recheck under T/N/F/R; deleted/stale ignored | QuarantineBoundaryTest/ScanJobBoundaryTest |
| grant revoke vs API auth / driver changes | no global ACL transaction lock; accepted auth window; next call resolves again | GuardFreshnessTest |
| share revoke vs fresh public read | share lookup after revoke commit fails; scope/trashed/scan rechecked per call | ShareSecurityBoundaryTest PG fork |
| withoutTenancy maintenance vs requests/jobs | scoped closure state; no global toggle; DB invariants use same locks | WithoutTenancyBoundaryTest + job A/B/A |

Implicit locks matter: conditional quota UPDATE locks drive row; FK INSERT references/locks parent rows; BlobStore commit locks C. Перед продуктовым edit executor сверяет этот порядок с актуальным кодом и проверяет complete→Ingest nested transaction closure. Не держать row F/Q при попытке получить более ранний T. Добавленный R prune должен использовать этот же порядок. GC не принимает tenant/user authority и не вызывает upload; не заводить новый C→T путь.
PG обеспечивает реальную проверку interleavings через P0.2 ForkRace barrier, отдельные connections/pids, tests fail без barrier/guard. SQLite подтверждает только serial semantics, 0 skips на required PG lanes. Данные PG только vaulter_test, preflight+isolation до первого mutating test. Negative controls ограничены одной проверяемой ошибкой, с восстановлением точных bytes; никаких Infection/Pest --mutate/score lanes.

C03 scan claim/settle: короткий claim lease lock; scanner IO вне tx; settle revalidates immutable revision/blob/scope + attempt fence, deleted/stale → no effect. PG ScanWorkRecoveryRaceTest. C07 sequence: no-op still compares expectation, retry preserves expectation; committed replay after scope/auth/payload verification no bump.

## I17/I18 concrete enforcement and lock additions

Current normative algorithms @plan/knowledge/P3-security-contracts.json. I17: no read-time rollout snapshot; immutable per-drive independent global/profile boundaries, admission at existing Q lock position, durable scan_backfill_runs when required legacy activation. Missing evidence is blocked regardless work discovery progress. Evidence compatible exact drive/tenant/immutable bytes/spec, sticky blob+revision infection; optional failed rescan retains valid prior clean.
Extended lock families: admit T→N→F→R→Q(counter+quota)→C→W/evidence inserts→A; activation exclusive T→Q→policy/backfill (no later N). Claim W-only short transaction commits before IO. Settle T→N→F→R→C→W→evidence; no W→T. Backfill per revision T→N→F→R→C→W→backfill cursor CAS last; scan/backfill recovery W-only reset then release before domain locks. Cleanup session S only, never re-ingest. Retained blobs remain GC-live via actual revision edges, work/evidence references prevent prune race until revision deleted. Purge deletes revision and cascade work/evidence then existing CAS saga; current head never reassigned by callback.
I18: all actual legacy Document/Yjs overwrite AND append branches use helper, not just drive mutations. Tests SEC-R18/19/20 split no-op/retry/replay/subtree/overflow; node sequence does not change scan/ACL/history dependencies, P6 owns strong validators. Strict P3 has no new conditional304 path; inventory guards and private/no-store actual responses, future cache/304 proof bound to P6. I4 private scanner exact attempt is independent of public asSystem and never a public OperationKind bypass. Each new enforcement has named D06 negative control in contracts Acceptance, executed only future product work. C05/C06/C09/C10 remain future owners; no product GREEN from this invariant model.
